Hi Ella —

Thanks again for the interest and for lining up the team. We reviewed the attendee list you sent and agree that a short intro demo will probably not give your engineers the hands-on confidence you need. Would you be open to converting the June 22 intro into a 90-minute engineering deep-dive / hands-on workshop instead?

Quick options from our side:
- Tue Jun 29, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Jul 1, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Jul 6, 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred if you need more prep time)

Attached is a draft agenda (agenda_v1.pdf) — it includes a short walkthrough, a guided lab (we'll provision a sandbox for your team), and time to map a POC plan. If Jul 6 works for you, we can also include our engineering lead and a short SOW sketch for procurement to review (I can loop Marissa).

Can you confirm preferred date and a final attendee list (roles)? Also flag any travel constraints we should avoid.

Best,
Jonas

- We'll plan a 90-minute workshop (10:00–11:30 PT) with a short intro, guided sandbox lab (we'll provision tokens + sample dataset), and a POC scoping session at the end.
- I'll attach a one-page SOW draft for procurement (SOW-draft.docx) and a short security pack.
- Can you confirm whether the engineers will need VPN/VPC access for the sandbox, or if they prefer we host an isolated demo environment?
- Please share any high-priority prompts/use-cases you want us to include in the lab (2–3 bullets).

Marissa — looping you in to confirm engineering attendance. Aditya, would you be able to lead the sandbox setup if Marissa is unavailable the week of Jun 22–28?
